title: The recommended mode
html:
The recommended mode

To get the most out of Golmet: Organization + FULL profile + Opencode. It is the tested path and the one this guide follows — the Organization gives you the structure and the shared knowledge, the FULL profile installs the complete workflow into your engine, and Opencode is the engine where the kit's capabilities run without reduction. Other engines work (with the essential profile, the kit lives versioned in the repo) — but it is this mode where nothing is missing. Details in docs/recommended.md.
